name: CNOT cancellation
summary: Two CNOT gates with the same control and target cancel.
description:
The CNOT gate is self-inverse. In the ZX-calculus this follows by fusing the two controls and the two targets with [spider fusion](../spider-fusion/), which leaves a Z- and an X-spider connected by two wires. The [Hopf rule](../hopf/) disconnects them, after which the remaining arity-2 spiders are [identities](../identity-removal/).

Each CNOT written as a Z-spider connected to an X-spider is $\frac{1}{\sqrt2}$ times the unitary, hence the scalar ½.
